problem.objective_name: negative net horizontal chassis displacement divided by full trial duration

constraints.name: fall observed (chassis ground contact or overturning)

scope: Continuous 20-second travel. Optimize net distance/time without falling. No slip, lift, requested-speed tracking, heading, steering or stopping rejection. Physical CAD, actuator and runtime model preserved. Parameter ranges are initial search windows to expand, not physical ceilings. Fall geometry is sampled; timestep and longer-distance confirmation follow promising results.
